prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
Rules:
- The same product has the same brand and the same model number. Differences in colour,
  capacity, size or bundle contents (when they change the model number) mean a different product.
- Ignore wording differences, marketing text and price differences.
- If no candidate is clearly the same product, answer "none". Do not guess.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>, "reason": "<short sentence>"}

Price-list item:
name: Tivo Wireless Adapter - AG0100; brand: tivo; description: Tivo Wireless Adapter - AG0100/ For Use With A TiVo Series 2 Only/ Flip-Up Antenna/ Optimized Wireless Performance

Candidates:
1. name: TiVo TCD658000 - HD XL Digital Video Recorder; brand: TiVo; price: $544.07
2. name: CHARGE YOUR UNIT WITH THIS AC ADAPTER CABLE. ALSO INCLUDES INTERNATIONAL ADAPTER - 010-10723-00; brand: Garmin
3. name: Tivo TIV652160 Tivo High Definition; brand: TiVo

response.text: {"choice": "none", "confidence": 1.0, "reason": "No candidate matches the brand and model number of the Tivo Wireless Adapter AG0100."}
